SWZ.note: AI named only as a reason for data governance; no rule or authority stated.

facts.fact: iMedias (dpa) reports Eswatini has its first national data governance policy, covering 2027-2031, prepared by the Ministry of ICT with GIZ and Smart Africa, with an implementation roadmap, monitoring framework and change-management plan; no adoption date or adopting body is given.

SWZ.note: No rule on sending data abroad stated.
Mentions international norms only in general terms; no standard or membership named.
Smart Africa supported the policy, but no membership, agreement or meeting by Eswatini with an African body is stated.
